data.description: A preserved biological specimen that is a fossil. Fossil specimens are physical vouchers and are expected to include one or more non-media parts.
An output of a human observation process. Human observations are unvouchered and are expected to have NO parts.
A biological specimen that is alive. Living specimens are physical vouchers and are expected to include one or more non-media parts.
An output of a machine observation process. Machine observations are media vouchers and are expected to have one or more media parts.
A biological specimen that has been preserved. Preserved specimens are physical vouchers and are expected to include one or more non-media parts.
An entity that can be identified, exists for some period of time, and consists in whole or in part of physical matter while it exists. Equivalent to Getty "item".
